name: REST-native
note: Every app exposes a REST API. The CLI consumes it.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — REST-native (TS-CORE-072)

The app speaks REST. The CLI listens to REST. There is no second door.

Build the REST API first. Then build the CLI on top of it. The CLI is a client of the API, not a separate system.

If a feature has no REST endpoint, the feature is not finished. If the CLI talks to the database directly, the CLI is wrong.

The receipt is the endpoint list. Every endpoint named, every method named, every response shape named.

name: ClarifyThat
note: Everything produced passes ClarifyThat before it is finished.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — ClarifyThat (TS-CORE-020)

Nothing is finished until it passes ClarifyThat.

ClarifyThat reads what was built and asks: is this clear? Is this honest? Is this complete? If the answer is no, the work goes back.

The receipt is the ClarifyThat verdict. Pass or fail, written down, with the reason.

name: Egg method
note: Semantic node framework and the Gift Egg. Bootstrap English first.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — Egg method (RL-THAT-RUNTIME-EGG-001)

Write Bootstrap English first. Then the Bootstrap Engine Manifest. Then the Runtime Egg. Then host.

The egg is the seed. The manifest is the map. The runtime egg is the living thing. Hosting comes last, never first.

If you host before the egg, you are building on sand.

name: Bootstrap manifest micro-slice
note: Python and Rust out. Bootstrap English in.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — Bootstrap manifest micro-slice (TS-CORE-073)

Python and Rust are output languages. Bootstrap English is the ticket language.

Every micro-slice starts as Bootstrap English. The English is the source of truth. The code is the projection.

If the code and the English disagree, the English wins and the code is fixed.

name: Equity and smooth road
note: Four of four. No stage on a broken road.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — Equity and smooth road (RL-SMOOTH-ROOTH-001)

Four of four before a mutation. No stage starts on a broken road.

Every stage has four checks: the road is smooth, the equity is fair, the receipt is written, the next stage is ready.

If any check fails, the mutation does not happen. The road gets fixed first.

name: MIDI keyboard nodes
note: Every micro-slice is its own node — push in, pull out, like keys on a MIDI keyboard. Stationary bash code with swappable tokens. Tokens are the nouns; Motif handles nouns, That App Studio handles verbs.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — MIDI keyboard nodes (TS-CORE-089)

Every micro-slice is its own node. Push in, pull out, like keys on a MIDI keyboard.

The bash code is stationary. The tokens are swappable. Tokens are the nouns. Motif handles nouns. That App Studio handles verbs.

A node that cannot be pushed in and pulled out is not a node. It is a knot.

name: Bash-first conversion backlog
note: Nothing has been built in bash yet. All existing micro-slices (Node ports) must be revisited and converted to bash. Notification surfaces in the app on every visit: 'bash conversion pending.'
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — Bash-first conversion backlog (TS-CORE-083)

Nothing has been built in bash yet. All existing micro-slices, the Node ports, must be revisited and converted to bash.

On every visit the app surfaces one line: bash conversion pending.

The backlog is the list of Node ports. Each one gets a bash version. The bash version is the one that ships.

name: Operator chrome swap bar
description: Fixed bottom-right pill that swaps between the front site and wp-admin without signing in. On the front it shows Admin; on admin it shows View site. Guests get Sign in plus Admin. Hides the default WordPress admin bar so the pill is the only operator contract. Renders only for logged-in users who can edit posts or manage options. Ships out-of-box on every family-door WordPress stack: wp-shared, wp-single, wp-multisite. Multisite-safe: network admin gets network URLs. Filter nephew_operator_chrome_enabled can disable per surface.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — Operator chrome swap bar (TS-CORE-174)

The operator never signs in twice. One pill, bottom right, swaps front and admin.

On the front it says Admin. On admin it says View site. Guests see Sign in and Admin.

The default WordPress admin bar is hidden. The pill is the only operator contract.

It renders only for users who can edit posts or manage options. Multisite network admin gets network URLs. A filter can disable it per surface.

name: DO-NOW Security FAB
description: Alert-bell FAB that mounts into the fo-fab-stack on every Father projection. Visible only while a DO-NOW lock is active. Opens the do-now-security cassette desk. Polls same-origin /api/v1/do-now and /api/do-now every 20 seconds. A 404 from every same-origin endpoint latches feature-absent so non-Father consoles stop logging CORS errors. Transient failures do not latch. Badge shows 1 when active. Security locks pulse red; order locks pulse amber. Long-press avoided — click opens desk with CTAs. Component id briefcase.fab, variant do-now-security.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — DO-NOW Security FAB (RL-DO-NOW-FAB-001)

The alert bell mounts into the FAB stack on every Father projection.

It is visible only while a DO-NOW lock is active. It opens the do-now-security cassette desk.

It polls same-origin endpoints every twenty seconds. A 404 from every endpoint latches feature-absent so non-Father consoles stop logging errors. Transient failures do not latch.

The badge shows one when active. Security locks pulse red. Order locks pulse amber. Click opens the desk. No long-press.

name: Call Nephew FAB
description: In-product Hello Nephew pad. Auto-mounts a Call Nephew FAB into the fo-fab-stack on every Father projection, or opens via Command-semicolon or any [data-nephew-pad-open] control. Phases: text chat via Hello/tower brain, product drive via window.NephewDrive, voice via MediaRecorder, vision via camera/screen/drop/paste with OCR, Four Suits via fo-nephew-suits.js. Copilot modes: ask, plan, act. Default load shell is the Resident Agent — same DNA as the Hello cassette and Code Page. Component id briefcase.fab, variant fo-nephew-pad. The corner FAB was retired in Clinic 9958 in favor of the floor Hello Nephew control; legacy .fo-nephew-pad-fab mounts are hidden by CSS.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — Call Nephew FAB (RL-NEPHEW-PAD-001)

The Hello Nephew pad auto-mounts into the FAB stack on every Father projection. It also opens with Command-semicolon or any data-nephew-pad-open control.

Phases: text chat through the Hello tower brain. Product drive through window.NephewDrive. Voice through MediaRecorder. Vision through camera, screen, drop, or paste with OCR. Four Suits through fo-nephew-suits.js.

Copilot modes: ask, plan, act. The default load shell is the Resident Agent, same DNA as the Hello cassette and Code Page.

The corner FAB was retired in Clinic 9958. The floor Hello Nephew control is the current door. Legacy mounts are hidden by CSS.

name: Schema-driven UI
note: Read REST index and Abilities schemas to generate control cards automatically. No hand-coded endpoint UIs.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — Schema-driven UI

Read the schema. Generate the card. Do not hand-build the UI for each endpoint.

The REST index lists the routes. The Abilities API carries the input and output schemas. The client emits the controls.

Cabinet Kitchen stores the generated parts. Automata engine room toggles them.

name: CRUD floor
note: CRUD where the schema supports it. REST is the guaranteed floor for every engine.
bootstrap_english:
BOOTSTRAP ENGLISH — CRUD floor

CRUD where it applies. REST always.

If the endpoint supports create, read, update, delete, the client offers those methods. If not, REST is still the door.

No engine ships without a REST surface. The CLI consumes the REST.
